## Summary
The team met to review the previous weekend's production and plan for the upcoming service. They finalized adjustments to the livestream timing, lighting cues, and slide content while discussing budget constraints regarding new equipment.

## Decisions
- The livestream start time will be moved to 9:25 AM.
- The second stage monitor will be put on hold until the budget resets in January.
- The opening lighting will use a dimmer preset to fade the house lights down and bring up the stage wash.

## Action items
- Speaker 2 — rebuild the announcement slides this week and ping Hannah for updated graphics.
- Aaron — reprogram the opening lighting cue before Thursday rehearsal.
- Aaron — check tracking on the camera 3 SDI cable tonight and update the group.

## Open questions
- Whether the new camera 3 cable will arrive before Sunday, and if not, if camera 3 will need to be moved.
- Whether the band will eventually switch to in-ear monitors (parked until next year's gear planning).

## Summary
The team met to finalize the November camera and graphics volunteer schedules, specifically addressing staffing limitations. They decided to man only two camera positions per service while keeping the wide shot locked and agreed to use a self-serve sign-up system through Planning Center.

## Decisions
- Use three cameras each weekend in November, with only the center close and side positions manned.
- Use Planning Center for camera volunteer sign-ups.
- Keep graphics sign-ups separate from camera sign-ups.
- Tyler will manage the graphics schedule.
- Dana will manage the camera schedule.

## Action items
- Aaron — build the draft schedule template (due Friday).
- Dana — nudge regulars to claim slots (due this weekend).
- Tyler — text Marcus to schedule a shadow weekend for graphics.
- Aaron — ask the worship team about the Thanksgiving weekend schedule.

## Open questions
- What is the service plan and volunteer availability for Thanksgiving weekend?
